property_summary: After a successful newGrantProposal call, the proposalCount value must equal the ID of the last created proposal stored in mapPID_grant; the mutant increments proposalCount after storing and emitting, so mapPID_grant for the new proposal is stored under the old proposalCount rather than the new one.
change_summary: Move 'proposalCount += 1' to after the emit, so proposalCount is incremented after storing the grant and emitting the event.
